name: Vigilnz AI Secure
description: AI security and prompt protection. Scans prompts and LLM responses for prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive data and policy violations using your Vigilnz AI Secure configuration.

apiKey.label: Vigilnz API Key
apiKey.description: Your Vigilnz API key (starts with vpsk_live_). Identifies your Vigilnz tenant and applies that tenant's AI Secure configuration.

baseUrl.label: Vigilnz Base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Vigilnz AI Secure environment to scan against, e.g. https://aigw.vigilnz.com for production or https://devaigw.vigilnz.com for development. Must use https. Path is appended automatically.

description.text: Sends the prompt (before the LLM call) or the completion (after the LLM call) to Vigilnz AI Secure and blocks or redacts it based on your tenant's policy configuration.
When enabled, Vigilnz returns a redacted version of the content instead of only a pass/fail verdict. Defaults to false.
Maximum time to wait for the Vigilnz AI Secure verdict. Defaults to 8000 ms.

failOnError.label: Fail the guardrail if Vigilnz is unreachable

description.text: When enabled, a Vigilnz outage, timeout or authentication failure fails this guardrail (fail-closed). When disabled, Portkey's default behaviour applies and an errored check does not fail the guardrail. Defaults to false.
